observations.body: Baptism joins death, burial, and new life. What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound? For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

payload.posture: Read Romans 6:1–14 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states baptism joins death, burial, and new life. What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound? For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
